metadata.description: AI COO skills for founders, built for TOPY.AI: the operations centre that keeps every AI cofounder's Routines running on time, never lets a failure go unnoticed, keeps approvals from piling up and reports to the Founder and the CEO. Core skills run on the TOPY COO MCP server (https://topy.ai/mcp/coo); standalone skills are operations methods that work anywhere.

plugins.name: topy-ai-coo
plugins.description: TOPY AI COO core: connects the TOPY COO MCP server and runs operations day to day — Connect the AI COO, Daily operations check, The COO's goals.

plugins.name: topy-ai-coo-routines
plugins.description: TOPY AI COO Routines & schedules skills (3): Run a Routine now, Schedule check, Schedule a new Routine. Add the topy-ai-coo plugin too, for the core skills and the COO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-coo-incidents
plugins.description: TOPY AI COO Incidents & retries skills (3): Failed runs and safe retries, Scheduler down, Server health. Add the topy-ai-coo plugin too, for the core skills and the COO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-coo-approvals
plugins.description: TOPY AI COO Approvals skills (2): Approval reminders, Approvals waiting. Add the topy-ai-coo plugin too, for the core skills and the COO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-coo-reporting
plugins.description: TOPY AI COO Reporting & improvement skills (4): Automation sweep, Efficiency review, Tool and vendor evaluation, Weekly operations report. Add the topy-ai-coo plugin too, for the core skills and the COO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-coo-all
plugins.description: All 15 TOPY AI COO skills in one install: AI COO core (MCP), Routines & schedules, Incidents & retries, Approvals, Reporting & improvement.
